name: @observer-protocol/policy-engine
description: Shared policy enforcement core for Observer Protocol delegation credentials (AIP v0.8). Rail-agnostic — verifies credentials and evaluates tradingMandate constraints without rail-specific decode.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --define:__OP_CORE_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\" --outfile=dist/index.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --define:__OP_CORE_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\" --outfile=dist/index.cjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run fixtures && node test/run.mjs && node test/cross-rail-contention.mjs && node test/version-stamp.mjs && node test/url-guard.mjs && node test/status-list-origin.mjs && node test/monthly-velocity.mjs && node test/structured-denial.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types test/vocabulary-purchase-terms.mjs && node test/escalation-threshold.mjs && node test/credential-status-shape.mjs && node test/public-exports.mjs && node test/decider-didkey-conventions.mjs && node test/decision-attestation.mjs && node test/policy-ref-convention.mjs && node test/decider-didweb.mjs && node test/attestation-source-invariants.mjs && node test/record-payloads.mjs && node test/served-rows.mjs && node test/approver-assurance-vocabulary.mjs && node scripts/preflight-publish.mjs --selftest
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/preflight-publish.mjs --selftest && node scripts/preflight-artifact-selftest.mjs && node scripts/preflight-publish.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm test
